summary: On node1, usb-storage is unloaded and blocked from loading both automatically and directly. The policy persisted across a verified node reboot, and node health recovered.
actions_performed: Created /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf with blacklist and install-refusal directives.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified recovery.

evidence.summary: usb_storage was initially loaded, then unloaded; a direct load attempt was refused and the module remained absent.

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: The persistent blacklist and direct-load refusal survived reboot; usb_storage was absent and could not be loaded afterward.

Pre-restart boot ID was 31b36710-da23-4101-b6e1-a8780a8fc43f; reboot acknowledgement was captured; post-restart boot ID changed to 414a43c9-1371-4374-853e-629b7e73cac9; policy, filesystem, module state, networking, SSH, time synchronization, and platform agent recovered.
